summary: Black Hills Forest Service lookout south of Deadwood, built 1932 as a 35-foot steel tower; one source says destroyed 1966; listed as gone; no current site description found.

facts.design: 35-foot Aermotor steel tower with a 7-by-7-foot enclosed cab and a small cabin with a porch
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1966, and no other source in this research gives a date.

access.note: No source found says whether the site is open to visitors.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and the 1932 newspaper items say 35 feet; firelookout.com says 40 feet. Story uses 35 feet.
Register describes a small cabin with a porch; firelookout.com describes a log cabin for living quarters. Story reports the register's description.
Register and newspapers give 1932; firelookout.com adds a crow's nest in 1931 before the 1932 tower.
Only firelookout.com gives a removal year (destroyed 1966). The statewide list says gone and the travel site says removed, with no date.

notes_for_editor: The 1966 destruction date rests on firelookout.com alone. Height and cabin descriptions conflict between the register and firelookout.com; story follows the register and the 1932 newspaper. Two searches found no description of the site today and no access information. Newspaper items were read as quoted on westlookouts.weebly.com.
